in_marathi.name: Kashvee
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kashvee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kashvee is derived from the Sanskrit words 'kash' meaning star and 'vee' meaning moonbeam. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Parvati is often depicted as a star or a moonbeam. Therefore, the name Kashvee symbolizes the divine feminine energy and the grace and beauty of the universe.
